## MC Hoster 3.0.1

- **Photos in feedback.** Send feedback (bug, idea or other) now has **Add photos…** (up to 3).
- **Feedback is not private anymore.** The Send feedback window says so: anyone who finds the secret can read it, with your names and photos.
- **A secret.** Click "by DarkerDawnFR" at the top 20 times in a row, without clicking or typing anything else, and a **Received feedback** button appears in the Server tab. It shows everything people sent, photos included.
